info.title: Micetro REST API
info.description:
Micetro is an API-first DDI solution. The Micetro REST API provides a RESTful way for accessing and managing 
resources within the system.\
Each API endpoint is a URL that uniquely identifies a resource, such as a DNS record, user, or DHCP server in 
Micetro.

Below you can find interactive documentation that lists all available resources. By expanding a resource, you can 
see a complete list of the operations that can be performed on that resource.\
Expanding an operation will give detailed descriptions of the required arguments and the expected response 
messages from Micetro.

For authorization, the REST API supports the `Bearer` HTTP authorization scheme.

To get started, create a session by sending a `POST` request to the 
[/sessions](/mmws/api/doc/#/micetro/post_micetro_sessions) endpoint, 
with a body containing the user's credentials: `{ loginName: string, password: string }`.\
The response result will contain a `session` field, that can be entered as the Bearer token in the dialog that 
opens after clicking the __Authorize__ button.

*Note*: If you have recently logged into Micetro in the same browser, this session may already be authorized, 
the step above not being required to start trying out the API here.

If you are looking for more information on how to get started with the Micetro REST API or want to see examples of 
how it can be used, see the [official documentation page](<https://docs.bluecatnetworks.com/r/Micetro-User-Guide/Micetro-REST-API/26.1.0>).
